channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: The Federal Reserve is expected to hike rates for the first time in three years: Live updates
item.description: Traders have assigned a better than 90% probability that the FOMC will vote to raise the overnight funds rate a quarter point.

item.title: OpenAI investors have approached the company about a new funding round
item.description: OpenAI is gearing up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO next year, after it confidentially filed its prospectus in June.

item.title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 10% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
item.description: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged more than 10% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.

item.title: World's top-performing sovereign wealth fund warns of looming pullback in U.S. stock market
item.description: New Zealand's $54 billion pension fund returned 14.2% in the year to June.

item.title: Bizarre volatility bet in the options pits is a head scratcher ahead of Fed rate decision
item.description: The biggest trade in options on the Cboe VIX Index Tuesday was an unusual $6 million purchase of deep, deep in-the-money-puts.

item.title: Growth stocks are still attractive compared to value even as rates rise, charts show
item.description: Todd Gordon breaks down the technical outlooks for growth and value stocks ahead of the key Fed decision.

item.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
item.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

item.title: Why you should worry about Anthropic, OpenAI's proposed AI risk evaluators
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI are proposing embedded AI evaluators to help manage risk of models causing catastrophic harm to society, but the idea has some issues.

item.title: Costco expands Uber Eats delivery partnership to 47 states
item.description: Uber and Costco announced an expansion of a partnership where Costco members can order delivery from the store on Uber Eats to 47 states, up from 17.

item.title: Senate is still a tossup, but Democrats now have slight edge, prediction market traders think
item.description: Traders on both Kalshi and Polymarket see Democrats with one of their best chances to flip the U.S. Senate since the contracts on the election opened.

item.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
item.description: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.

item.title: Living abroad doesn't end your U.S. tax obligations. What young expats need to know
item.description: Americans living overseas may still face U.S. tax-filing and foreign-account reporting rules — even when they ultimately owe no U.S. income tax.

item.title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is getting a makeover as it prepares for its 'next 3,000' locations
item.description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe unveiled new branding as it grows rapidly under the ownership of private equity firm Blackstone.

item.title: The Fed is expected to raise rates. There's a bearish trade to be made on this homebuilder
item.description: Tony Zhang breaks down how he's trading this homebuilder stock.

item.title: Reddit co-founder says tech industry has been 'tone deaf' in explaining AI: 'Misinformation flying around'
item.description: Alexis Ohanian said AI risks are more mundane than the "Terminator and Skynet" scenarios some fear.

item.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
item.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

item.title: Mortgage demand from homebuyers drops 19% from a year ago, as interest rates surge abruptly higher
item.description: Mortgage rates have surged to the highest level since the start of 2025, causing a major pullback in mortgage demand.

item.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
item.description: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

item.title: Oil prices fall after U.S. says damaged Saudi pipeline will restart operations in days
item.description: The pipeline has allowed the Saudis to shift oil exports to the Red Sea while the U.S. and Iran battle for control over Hormuz.

item.title: Advil-maker Haleon boosts sales by targeting consumers on weight-loss drugs
item.description: Advil maker Haleon is capitalizing on the GLP-1 boom, boosting sales of products that combat weight loss drugs side effects with strategic store placement.

item.title: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows
item.description: Travelers gave higher ratings in part because of the newer gates and terminals many airports have opened in recent years, according to the study.

item.title: Here are 5 of the best online prenup services
item.description: Compare top prenup platforms for affordability, flat fees, collaboration and expert guidance.

item.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.

item.title: AWS says it can't restore service to Bahrain, UAE facilities 6 months after Iran strikes
item.description: In March, two Amazon data centers in the UAE were struck by drones, while a site was also damaged by a nearby drone hit.

item.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
item.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

item.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
item.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

item.title: Americans' incomes rose and poverty fell in 2025, Census Bureau says
item.description: The data comes as the Federal Reserve is considering interest-rate increases that could slow economic growth.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Huang attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi: Source
item.description: Jensen Huang appeared to side with Trump as the president pushed back on tech CEOs' warnings about the risks of rapid AI advancement.

item.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar tells CNBC she isn't worried about slowing AI development
item.description: Friar joined CNBC's Jim Cramer on "Mad Money" as the debate over technology's safety risks rages on.

item.title: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
item.description: Ukraine's sanctions envoy said Russia could be forced to retreat from the war within six months if its oil revenues are halved.
